message.content: The kernel uses Kahan summation in fp32; with a ±2^80 dominant pair and a permutation that can interleave ±2^30 with the small values, the correction term itself accumulates in fp32 and can lose the low-magnitude values. The recorded probe shows failure, but its reference (all zeros) looks questionable, so I'll run my own probe with an exact-target computation.
